svg.title: The slope field of dy/dx equals x minus y with one solution curve drawn through the marked point (0, 2). Going right, the curve falls to a minimum on the dashed line y equals x, at about (1.1, 1.1), then rises and runs just above the dotted line y equals x minus 1, getting closer to it. Going left from (0, 2), the curve climbs steeply off the top of the diagram.
